title: apricity-engine::clock: the clock line and its beat, frame and bar-line math
description:
## Intent
The clock math, pure and wasm-able.

## Steps
1. New module `crates/apricity-engine/src/clock.rs`, exported from `lib.rs`: `ClockLine { beat_at: f64, frame_at: u64, tempo: f64, playing: bool, quantum: u32 }`, with beat at a frame, frame of a beat at a sample rate, next bar line at or after a beat, and phase within the quantum.
2. `Copy` data only, so it can cross to the audio thread through the existing command ring (`Command` in `mixer.rs`).
3. Unit tests with exact cases: bar lines at quantum 3 and 4, tempo 20 and 999 BPM, a beat exactly on a bar line, negative beats (Link beats can be negative before a start).

## Verify
`cargo test -p apricity-engine clock::` and `cargo build -p apricity-engine --no-default-features --target wasm32-wasip1`.

Commit: `feat(<this task id>): engine clock line`.

## Protocol
Specs first, watched red; log decisions, problems and outcomes with `kbs comment`; run Verify and paste the tail. Every Bash call starts `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && cd /Users/home/Projects/Apricity`; cargo with `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 RUST_TEST_THREADS=2` under `safe-run.sh --`. Never change dependencies to make a build pass. Sub-agents never commit, push or close.
